text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: How should I run this time? Obviously, pull away with a huge swoooosh at the end...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, of course!
I've gotta show off my absolute coolest self, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Because the fans today came specifically looking forward to seeing me do great, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then I've gotta live up to their expectations♪
It'd be such a pity for everyone otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes on me too, Trainer!
Watch how I run!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"And then everyone can hype it up big time!
Right at the moment I take victory!"
